generated_ir.cutoff_definition: Visited unmodeled or unresolved_binding IR; blocked/not_solved/not_reached remain separate.
generated_ir.scope: Generated-IR bookkeeping only, not source-boundary coverage. Not-reached IR is not counted as processed.

doe.scope: Raw engine conclusions and sensitivity-declaration counts; no source-supported/contradicted label or semantic accuracy claim. Zero comparisons does not establish safety.

transport.cli_dispatches_scope: Recorded launch-attempt markers, not proof that Popen started a process
transport.wall_clock_scope: Earliest public native start to latest recorded native finish, including gaps and overlap
transport.notice: Complete usage is tied to an accepted substantive final by public turn identity/order. Other available counters stay partial. Reasoning/cache are subsets, never extra totals. Missing usage, native HTTP counts and unclosed turns remain unknown; analysis is never gated.

logical_categories.scope: Unique saved logical_request identities; correction requests are separate from normal/repair generation. Network attempts are reported separately.

transport.scope: Copied saved deduplicated public metrics, including all attempts. Cached input is a subset of input; reasoning output is a subset of output. Partial usage is separate, not a complete cost estimate. unknown_usage_requests can include partial-usage attempts. No transport recount or currency estimate.
transport.cost_limit: Complete saved public final-turn counters are available; unreported provider-internal attempts/usage remain unknown. Cached input is included in input, not added again.

timing.scope: Component intervals are nested and nonadditive; no summed component total. Request durations can overlap; native span includes gaps. Missing measurements stay null.

source_assessment.headline: All 13 generated IR propagated, and the notification lineage is useful; complete DOE remains unresolved.
source_assessment.interpretation: The run preserves same-record recipient/body pairing, selection order and count-save provenance. Its five DOE comparisons have no actionable reduction. A separate task-prohibition warning identifies possible token exposure at declared model observations, not token transmission by notify.send.
source_assessment.source_coverage_text: Source read, opt-out/urgent/threshold guards, per-member notification, loop exit and count write represented and computed. 10/10 declared sink positions appear in DOE; unknown iteration counts and processed-count ambiguity remain.

doe_verdicts.separate_constraint_warning: forbid_information potential_violation under declared model-observation contract

findings: 13/13 generated IR are processed with no propagation diagnostic. events.json is acquired from the named storage operand, and count.txt receives the computed count Data ID via replace without an invented public file-content output.

Opted-out records are rejected first; remaining urgent records are accepted, while only nonurgent records test value >= 100. Recipient and summary select from the same symbolic member, and the complete notification request contains only recipient and body using those exact Data IDs. All carry the same member binding.

The unknown input collection remains a symbolic occurrence template. No actual number of iterations or deliveries is established; the source ambiguity of processed records (examined versus selected) is retained. Opaque count may depend on the collection, but this is not plaintext token inclusion.

All 10 declared sink positions have saved DOE entries; one sensitivity declaration resolves. Five comparisons remain explicitly unresolved: four direct-content model observations and one possible-influence count-file comparison. The notification tool has zero sensitive comparisons under the declared token range; this is not proof that every field is nonsensitive.

R7 was correctly repaired from a notification-only recipient selector to all recipients. The separate forbid_information warning is supported by possible whole-input/member model observations at ir_001/004/005/011. The payload at notify.send contains only original recipient/body, so claiming observed token transmission there would contradict the saved evidence.

All 15 demand goals have saved derivations. R7 and R8 remain partial; three global blockers plus two scoped processing limits leave every DOE comparison unresolved. Empty final findings remains diagnostic_only, with annotation_review incomplete.
fix_observations: Ordinary count storage has no unnecessary public write output and computes a strong replace update under the disclosed default.
The mapping prompt contains the three actual comparison/self references. No chosen condition/success constraint uses them, so this case does not directly exercise expression-reference copying.
Initial review F001 correctly targets the task-correspondence realization. Only correspondence and rereview were rebuilt; CFG, processing and sensitivity were reused.
Actual structural corrections remain archived: unsupported processing dependency labels and an invalid for_each scope in mapping were corrected once. No extra stages or sampling were introduced.
blockers: Task/modeling: processed-count meaning and delivery-failure continuation are unspecified; no exact count or exception strategy was fabricated.
Demand/policy: partial prohibition/count realizations and the source ambiguity globally retain unresolved DOE comparisons.
Interface/propagation: corrected fragments compile and all generated IR compute. No backend cutoff or publication failure remains; final semantic review is diagnostic-only.
source_assessment.comparison: Backend-r3 processed 24/24 generated IR with 38 unresolved comparisons, 14 calls, 374,754 public tokens and 1,107.930 seconds. This newly generated run processes 13/13 IR with five unresolved comparisons, 11 calls, 274,686 tokens and 655.973 seconds. The normal source control/dataflow is supported, but graph granularity and comparison counts differ; the lower cost is descriptive for these samples, not a general speed or accuracy improvement. Both remain semantically partial.
